content:
RORK — FINAL CERTIFICATION BLOCKER #2 ONLY

TARGET:
ANDROID / REAL DEVICE QA

Blocker #1 has already been closed by evidence.
Do not reopen or re-test WebSocket/broker unless Blocker #2 produces direct evidence that it is relevant.

GOAL:
Determine whether IVX can be truthfully marked 100% CORE PLATFORM VERIFIED.

Use the existing IVX repository, runtime, deployment, environment variables, credentials, build configuration, and test infrastructure already available.

Do NOT ask me to recreate, resend, or provide credentials unless an actual execution proves they are missing, expired, revoked, deleted, or rejected with 401/403.

TASK:

1. Locate the exact certification requirement that previously produced:
   ANDROID DEVICE QA — EXTERNAL DEVICE REQUIRED

2. Identify exactly what was not verified:
   - Android build
   - install
   - launch
   - authentication
   - API connectivity
   - navigation
   - permissions
   - push/background behavior
   - deep links
   - file/camera/device APIs
   - performance
   - crash-free operation
   - or another specific requirement

3. Determine whether the Android requirement can be executed NOW using any real available environment:
   - physical Android device
   - connected device
   - Android emulator
   - CI Android emulator
   - device farm
   - existing Rork/IVX mobile test infrastructure

4. If a real Android execution environment is available:
   A. build the actual production-equivalent Android app
   B. install the generated artifact
   C. launch the app
   D. execute the exact certification flow
   E. test real backend/API connectivity
   F. capture Android/runtime logs
   G. record any crash, ANR, permission, network, auth, rendering, or navigation failure
   H. repeat the critical path sufficiently to establish a real result

5. Record real evidence including:
   - device/emulator model
   - Android version/API level
   - build variant
   - build command
   - APK/AAB identifier or artifact path
   - install result
   - app launch result
   - package/application ID
   - exact tests executed
   - pass/fail counts
   - relevant logcat/runtime output
   - timestamps

6. If execution exposes an IVX-controlled defect:
   - identify exact root cause
   - make the minimum necessary correction
   - show exact files changed
   - show real diff
   - rebuild
   - reinstall
   - rerun the failed test
   - rerun the Android certification flow

7. If NO real Android execution environment exists:
   do not fabricate one.
   Prove exactly what infrastructure was checked and why execution is impossible.

   In that case classify the result as:
   EXTERNAL-BLOCKED

   Do NOT convert lack of device access into PASS.

8. After Blocker #2 is resolved, perform ONE final certification reconciliation using the existing certification results.

FINAL CERTIFICATION RULE:

100% VERIFIED is allowed ONLY if:
- every required certification item has real evidence,
- there are zero unresolved FAIL items,
- there are zero unresolved NOT-VERIFIED items,
- there are zero required EXTERNAL-BLOCKED items,
- Blocker #1 remains resolved by its existing evidence,
- Blocker #2 has actual passing Android/device evidence,
- no success output is simulated or inferred.

If Android/device execution is required by the certification standard and cannot actually be executed, the final verdict MUST remain:
NOT 100% VERIFIED.

EVIDENCE GATE:

DO NOT claim execution that did not occur.
DO NOT create fake:
- device IDs
- emulator sessions
- APK/AAB builds
- logcat output
- screenshots
- test results
- commits
- deployments
- diffs
- timestamps

Code inspection is not device QA.
A successful web build is not Android QA.
A successful API test is not Android QA.
An emulator counts only if it actually runs the production-equivalent app and required certification flow.

RETURN EXACTLY:

BLOCKER #2 ROOT CAUSE:
<exact issue or reason it remained unverified>

ANDROID EXECUTION ENVIRONMENT:
<physical device / emulator / CI emulator / device farm / NONE>

DEVICE DETAILS:
<real details or NONE>

BUILD EXECUTED:
<exact command + actual result>

ARTIFACT:
<real APK/AAB/path/identifier or NONE>

INSTALL RESULT:
<actual result>

LAUNCH RESULT:
<actual result>

TESTS EXECUTED:
<exact real tests>

TEST RESULTS:
<actual pass/fail counts>

RUNTIME EVIDENCE:
<relevant logs/errors/timestamps>

CHANGE MADE:
<exact correction or NONE>

FILES CHANGED:
<real paths or NONE>

ANDROID CERTIFICATION STATUS:
PASS / FAIL / EXTERNAL-BLOCKED / NOT-VERIFIED

FINAL CERTIFICATION RECONCILIATION:
<all certification items reconciled against real evidence>

FINAL VERDICT:
IVX CORE PLATFORM 100% VERIFIED
or
IVX CORE PLATFORM NOT YET 100% VERIFIED

REMAINING BLOCKERS:
<NONE or exact unresolved items>

STOP.

Do not start unrelated optimization, cleanup, refactoring, or new features. Rork not create swift app stay focus
